reason: generated code, not ours: the Dafny Java translation of the proved goal kernel (formal/dafny/Goal.dfy) together with the Dafny runtime, written by formal/dafny/build-native.sh into src/dafny-goal and byte-compared with a fresh translation in CI, so a mutant of it could only be killed by testing Dafny itself. Its correctness is the Dafny proof plus the replay of the kernel tape corpus; the hand-written bridge (net/atlasauth/pca/goal/GoalKernel.java) is mutated like the rest of the SDK. PIT never reaches it: the pom's targetClasses is net.atlasauth.pca.*, and the translation lives in the top-level packages GoalApi, GoalIr, GoalCompile, GoalWitness, GoalRender, dafny and _System.
